presets.name: Ultimate Gaming Rig
presets.tagline: Maximum FPS, zero micro-stutter, and complete gaming launcher ecosystem
presets.description: Deploys Steam, Heroic, Lutris, ProtonUp-Qt, MangoHud overlay, GameMode daemon, Discord, and tunes kernel memory maps (vm.max_map_count=2147483642) and swappiness for stutter-free gaming.

presets.name: AI & Developer Workstation
presets.tagline: Full-stack web, Python AI, Docker containers, Rust, and modern shell
presets.description: Installs VS Code, Docker CE Engine & Compose, Astral uv, Ollama local LLM runner, Node.js LTS (fnm), Rustup toolchain, Starship prompt, eza, bat, and zoxide.

presets.name: Minimalist & Privacy Debloat
presets.tagline: Strip telemetry, boost battery life, optimize RAM, and secure DNS
presets.description: Removes Ubuntu crash reporter daemons, silences ESM command line spam, configures Cloudflare/Quad9 DNS-over-TLS, enables UFW firewall, purges old Snap revisions, and installs LibreWolf & Bitwarden.

presets.name: Content Creator Studio
presets.tagline: Pro video editing, 3D modeling, streaming, and audio mastering suite
presets.description: Configures OBS Studio with hardware NVENC/VA-API acceleration, Blender, Kdenlive, GIMP, Krita, Audacity, HandBrake, and optimizes low-latency PipeWire audio stack.
